Generic for grid facets

Source: R/split.R
split_grid.Rd

Generic for grid facets

Usage

split_grid(
  plot,
  ...,
  rows = NULL,
  cols = NULL,
  scales = "fixed",
  space = "fixed"
)

Arguments

plot

A plotit object.

...

Unnamed arguments are shorthand for rows (e.g. Species becomes rows = vars(Species)). Named arguments (labeller, switch, ...) are passed through to ggplot2::facet_grid().

rows, cols

Variables to facet by, wrapped in ggplot2::vars().

scales

Should scales be fixed ("fixed"), free ("free"), or free in one dimension ("free_x", "free_y")?

space

Should the space be fixed ("fixed"), free ("free"), or free in one dimension ("free_x", "free_y")?

Value

A modified plotit object.

Examples

plotit(iris, encode(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length)) |>
  mark_point() |>
  split_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(Species))
